item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
A US-brokered ceasefire now covers Oleshky and has been extended across the Kherson region, while local ceasefires operate in other frontline cities. Russian forces were blamed for a fire in the Russian city of Lipetsk after a reported Ukrainian strike, and Ukrainian forces recaptured territory, according to President Zelenskiy. President Putin held calls with the leaders of Finland and Norway, discussed Russian history, and faced split opinions among European leaders, while talks about lifting sanctions on a Russian investment fund continued. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces have intensified a crackdown in Hebron, displacing thousands and prompting UN warnings of ethnic cleansing, while IDF raids have expelled farmers and settlers have attacked olive pickers. The parliamentary election remains deadlocked, with no clear winner and exit polls showing a narrow edge for the opposition amid record turnout. Gaza’s women filmmakers have launched a new academy to turn pain into cinema, and a Hebron groom was caught in a military lockdown. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel and Hezbollah: the situation
item.description:
Hezbollah continues to fire rockets and artillery at Israeli positions in southern Lebanon while Israel carries out air strikes on Hezbollah sites, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF investigation. Lebanese olive harvests proceed under the threat of drones and warplanes, and UN peacekeepers are withdrawing from Lebanon after pressure from Israel. Qatar has pledged reconstruction funding and announced a large solar plant project for southern Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
The Houthis have intensified attacks on Saudi Arabia, striking the Ras Tanura oil refinery and prompting Saudi air defenses to intercept missiles over the capital, while also firing a second missile at Yemen’s Aden airport and urging its evacuation as fighting escalates. Gulf states are negotiating a multipart peace deal to prevent a renewed US-Iran war, and Egypt’s parliament has approved military support for Saudi Arabia. Russian satellites are being used to guide Houthi strikes on Saudi targets. These actions have contributed to higher oil prices. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Iraq: the situation
item.description:

Yazidi militia units linked to the PKK are disarming and joining the Iraqi army, and other militia groups have pledged to disarm by mid‑2027. The prime minister visited Damascus, dismissed four officers for allowing the PMF to desecrate a US flag, and announced a reshuffle of more than 50 posts amid disputes over Sinjar security and YBS integration under federal authority. The conflict produced 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

In the Blue Nile, the Sudanese Armed Forces repelled a fresh RSF and SPLM-N assault, seizing 15 combat vehicles. Women under siege are increasingly acting as frontline responders to meet basic needs as the war grinds on. World leaders are urging urgent aid access as the United Nations warns of a looming famine risk. The conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
